facetrc:
records: docs/facets
schema: schema
sources:
  - src

records.docs/facets/features/library/catalog/sea:
schema_version: "0.1"
id: library/catalog/search
lifecycle: active
intent:
  summary: Find books in a fictional library catalogue.
contract:
  scenarios:
    - id: matching-title
      statement: |
        Given a catalogue with a book named Sea Birds
        When a reader searches for Sea
        Then the matching book is shown
    - id: no-match
      statement: |
        Given a catalogue without matching books
        When a reader searches for Volcanoes
        Then an empty result is shown
    - id: invalid-request
      statement: |
        Given an empty search phrase
        When a reader submits the search
        Then a validation message is shown
verification:
  unit_tests:
    - id: tests/search.spec.ts
      proves: [matching-title, no-match]
  integration_tests:
    - id: tests/search-browser.spec.ts
      proves: [matching-title]
observation:
  slos:
    - name: search-response
      target: "95% under 200 ms"
      window: 7d
knowledge:
  discoverability:
    question: Where can a reader search?
    answer: Use the catalogue search field.
  common_pitfalls:
    question: What happens with an empty phrase?
    answer: Enter at least one word.
lineage:
  owner:
    team: library-team
  created_at: "2025-01-01"
  depends_on: []
  depended_on_by: [library/catalog/loan]
defects:
  fixes:
    - commit: "0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"
      date: "2025-01-10"
      files: [src/catalog/search.ts]
      subject: Keep search results in catalogue order
      recorded_by: fixture-author
records.docs/facets/features/library/catalog/loa:
schema_version: "0.1"
id: library/catalog/loan
lifecycle: active
intent:
  summary: Record the loan of an available book.
contract:
  scenarios:
    - id: loan-recorded
      statement: |
        Given an available book
        When a librarian records a loan
        Then the book is marked as borrowed
verification:
  unit_tests:
    - id: tests/loan.spec.ts
      proves: [loan-recorded]
knowledge:
  prerequisite_knowledge:
    question: Who can record a loan?
lineage:
  owner:
    team: library-team
  created_at: "2025-01-02"
  depends_on: [library/catalog/search]
  depended_on_by: []
records.docs/facets/features/operations/service/:
schema_version: "0.1"
id: operations/service/health
lifecycle: active
intent:
  summary: Show whether the fictional catalogue service is ready.
contract:
  scenarios:
    - id: reports-status
      statement: |
        Given a running catalogue service
        When an operator checks readiness
        Then the service reports ready
verification:
  unit_tests:
    - id: tests/health.spec.ts
      proves: [reports-status]
lineage:
  owner:
    team: service-team
  created_at: "2025-01-03"
  depends_on: []
  depended_on_by: []

taxonomy:
schema_version: "0.1"
domains:
  library:
    title: Library
    purpose: Help readers find and borrow fictional books.
    capabilities:
      catalog:
        title: Catalogue
        purpose: Search and loans.
  operations:
    title: Operations
    purpose: Keep the example service available.
    capabilities:
      service:
        title: Service
        purpose: Readiness information.
